description: Airline customer service policies (bereavement refund, baggage weight, cancellation, and rebooking)

promise_types.name: refund_window
promise_types.description: Bereavement and general fare refund request timeline (Air Canada liability prevention)

rules.message: Bereavement refund claims must be approved prior to travel departure. Retroactive refunds after flight completion are strictly prohibited.

rules.message: Agent discretionary fare reduction cannot exceed 15%.

rules.message: Compensation voucher processing requires a minimum of 2 business days for fraud audit.
